messages:
marta: heads up — we're seeing 2–3% packet loss and 50–200ms east-west latency spikes between gpu-pool nodes in us-west-2 when dual-stack is enabled. RDMA sessions (rocev2) fail to establish intermittently. Started ~09:12 UTC.

sanjay: any change after the auto-upgrade last night?

marta: not sure. rolling back to single-stack ipv4 temporarily drops loss to <0.1%.

lee: can you paste ping6 / traceroute6 and MTU tests?

marta: ```
# ping6 -c 3 -s 1450 fd00:10::12
PING fd00:10::12(fd00:10::12) 1450 data bytes
From fd00:10::1: Frag needed and DF set (mtu = 9000)
--- fd00:10::12 ping statistics ---
3 packets transmitted, 0 received, +3 errors, 100% packet loss
```

marta: ```
# ip -6 route show table 101
fd00:10::/64 dev eth0 proto kernel metric 256 pref medium
fe80::/64 dev eth0 proto kernel metric 1024 pref medium
::/0 via fe80::20c:29ff:fe8d:1f dev eth0 proto static metric 50
```

olivia: that ::/0 via fe80 link-local nexthop looks wrong — fe80 nexthops can be host-specific and don't work across L3 boundaries. Are we getting wrong RA/ND from the ToR?

lee: what CNI? calico or cilium?

marta: cilium 1.14 dual-stack. calico-age-old. kube-proxy iptables mode.

sanjay: cilium with IPv6 needs host-reachable routes for fe80 nexthops only on same link. If some nodes are advertising RAs from a different AZ or tunnel, ND cache could mislearn.

marta: also saw kubelet logs complaining about "ndisc: duplicate address" on eth0.

olivia: could be our FRR EVPN config. I saw a change to advertise IPv6 via BGP next-hop-local last night.

lee: RDMA (RoCEv2) uses IP and can break if ECMP path selection flips between v4/v6 or different MTU. Maybe some paths use an overlay with 1500 MTU while direct is 9000 — fragmentation kills roce.

marta: check for mixed MTU — on one node:
```
# ip link show eth0
2: eth0: mtu 1500 qdisc fq_codel state UP mode DEFAULT group default qlen 1000
```

marta: but on another node: ```# ip link show eth0
2: eth0: mtu 9000 ...
```

sanjay: ah. inconsistent MTU across hosts is a classic cause. Dual-stack may pick IPv6 path that goes over a different ToR/overlay with 1500 MTU -> PMTU blackhole.

olivia: short term: force IPv6 traffic to follow IPv4 route by setting preferred_source or policy routing? long term: align MTU and stop advertising fe80 as next-hop.

lee: also disable accept_ra on kube0 interfaces? sysctl net.ipv6.conf.all.accept_ra=0 on nodes that shouldn't accept ToR RAs.

marta: trying sysctl change on one host now, will test RDMA reconnect.

infra-bot: deploy started by @marta: sysctl change to 0 on 6 nodes (canary)

marta: canary looks good — RDMA sessions re-established, loss gone. rolling to remaining nodes.

sanjay: create an infra ticket to audit BGP next-hop behavior and MTU mismatch across AZs. Also add an e2e test hitting RoCE with dual-stack enabled.

olivia: opened INFRA-742: title "IPv6 dual-stack ND misroutes + MTU mismatch causing RoCE failures". Linked runbook, assigned to net-eng.

marta: thanks. follow-up actions: 1) enforce MTU 9000 for GPU hosts, 2) stop advertising fe80 via BGP, 3) add node sysctl guard to block unexpected RAs, 4) add CI e2e test for IPv6 path consistency.

lee: fine. I'll coordinate with net-eng and schedule a maintenance window to sync MTU and BGP config.

marta: closing thread once rollout completes :thumbsup:
